scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/frontend" "npm run dev -w apps/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/frontend && npm run build -w apps/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/frontend && npm run test -w apps/backend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm run test:watch -w apps/frontend" "npm run test:watch -w apps/backend"
